note: Hand-checked data center deals, corporate tax breaks and corporate lobbying of NJ municipal officials. Each entry cites the public sources it was checked against. Only actions by the municipality itself (or lobbying aimed at its officials) belong here; state-level awards are noted as context. Deals that were proposed and then dropped or banned are left out. Applied by scripts/nj/red-flags.mjs.

deals.label: Data center tax break (PILOT)
deals.detail: City council adopted a five-year payment-in-lieu-of-taxes (PILOT) ordinance for DataOne's hyperscale AI data center: a 100% property-tax discount in year one, then 20% to 80% discounts in years two through five.

New Jersey freezes $250 million in data center tax incentives (June 4, 2026)

deals.label: Data center rezoning
deals.detail: The former Merck campus was rezoned for data centers in September 2024. CoreWeave is building a $1.8 billion, 250-megawatt AI data center there, backed by a $250 million state tax credit (NJ Economic Development Authority, November 2025).

deals.label: Corporate lobbying of town officials
deals.detail: Public records show an attorney at Archer & Greiner, CoreWeave's law firm, emailed borough counsel scripted TV talking points for the mayor defending the data center's power and water use.
